mapper.select: select t1.source_number, t1.source_name, t1.type_number, t1.source_table, (select cc.eas_bp_code from con_contract cc where cc.eas_bp_name = t1.source_name and cc.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1) eas_code, #{contractId} as source_id from (select 'HX' || replace( wm_concat(v.bp_id) , ',', '/') as source_number, replace(wm_concat(v.bp_name), ',', '/') as source_name, '01' as type_number, 'CON_CONTRACT' as source_table from (select h.bp_id, h.bp_name from con_contract cc, hls_bp_master h, prj_project_bp bp where cc.project_id = bp.project_id and bp.bp_categroy = 'CON_CONTRACT' and h.bp_id = bp.bp_id and bp.bp_type in ('TENANT', 'TENANT_SEC') and cc.contract_id = #{contractId} order by h.bp_id) v) t1

select nvl(h.eas_bp_code,'HX'||h.bp_code) as source_number, h.bp_name as source_name, '04' as type_number, h.bp_name as description ,h.bp_id as source_id,'HLS_BP_MASTER' as source_table from con_contract cc, hls_bp_master h, prj_project_bp bp where cc.project_id = bp.project_id and bp.bp_categroy = 'CON_CONTRACT' and h.bp_id = bp.bp_id and bp.bp_type ='VENDER' and exists (select 1 from hls_bp_master_role hr where hr.bp_id=h.bp_id and hr.enabled_flag='Y') and cc.contract_id=#{contractId} and not exists (select 1 from eas_source_record e where e.source_id=h.bp_id and e.source_table='HLS_BP_MASTER' and e.source_type='04' and e.code in ('200', '101'))

select cc.eas_code as source_number, cc.contract_number as source_name, '05' as type_number, cc.contract_name as description ,cc.contract_id as source_id,'CON_CONTRACT' as source_table,cc.eas_code from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id=#{contractId} and not exists (select 1 from eas_source_record e where e.source_id=cc.contract_id and e.source_table='CON_CONTRACT' and e.source_type='05' and e.code in('200','101'))

select nvl(fo.eas_code,'HX'||fo.unit_id) as source_number, fo.unit_name as source_name, 'bm' as type_number, fo.unit_name as description,cc.unit_id as source_id,'FND_ORG_UNIT' as source_table from con_contract cc,fnd_org_unit fo where cc.unit_id=fo.unit_id and cc.contract_id=#{contractId} and not exists (select 1 from eas_source_record e where e.source_id=cc.unit_id and e.source_table='FND_ORG_UNIT' and e.source_type='bm' and e.code in('200','100','101'))

select fc.ws_com_code as source_number, fc.fin_company_name as source_name, '11' as type_number, fc.fin_company_name as description, fc.company_id as source_id, 'FND_COMPANY' as source_table
from con_contract cc, fnd_company fc where cc.company_id = fc.company_id and cc.contract_id = #{contractId} and not exists (select 1 from eas_source_record e where e.source_id = fc.company_id and e.source_table = 'FND_COMPANY' and e.source_type = '11' and e.code in ('200', '101')) union all select fc.ws_com_code as source_number, fc.fin_company_name as source_name, '11' as type_number, fc.fin_company_name as description, fc.company_id as source_id, 'FND_COMPANY' as source_table
from con_contract cc, fnd_company fc where cc.company_spv = fc.company_id and cc.contract_id = #{contractId} and not exists (select 1 from eas_source_record e where e.source_id = fc.company_id and e.source_table = 'FND_COMPANY' and e.source_type = '11' and e.code in ('200', '101')) union all select distinct nvl(h.eas_bp_code,'HX'||h.bp_code) as source_number, h.bp_name as source_name, '11' as type_number, h.bp_name as description, h.bp_id as source_id, 'HLS_BP_MASTER' as source_table from con_contract cc, hls_bp_master h, prj_project_bp bp where cc.project_id = bp.project_id and bp.bp_categroy = 'CON_CONTRACT' and h.bp_id = bp.bp_id and cc.contract_id = #{contractId} and not exists (select 1 from eas_source_record e where e.source_id = h.bp_id and e.source_table = 'HLS_BP_MASTER' and e.source_type = '11' and e.code in ('200', '101'))

select nvl(lnn.if_from_contract, 'N') if_from_contract, lnn.bp_bank_account_name, lnn.bp_id, (select t1.eas_code from csh_payment_req_ln t1 where t1.bp_bank_account_name = lnn.bp_bank_account_name and lnn.eas_code is not null and rownum=1) eas_pay_code, (select h.eas_bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = lnn.bp_bank_account_name and h.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1) eas_pay_bp_code, (select h.bp_id from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = lnn.bp_bank_account_name and h.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1) eas_pay_bp_id, (select h.eas_bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_id = lnn.bp_id) eas_bp_code, (select h.bp_name from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_id = lnn.bp_id) bp_name, (select count(*) from eas_source_record eas where eas.source_table='HLS_BP_MASTER' and eas.source_id=lnn.bp_id and eas.source_type='04' and eas.code in ('200', '101'))eas_bp_count, lnn.payment_req_ln_id as source_id, 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_LN' as source_table from csh_payment_req_ln lnn where lnn.payment_req_id=#{paymentReqId}

select t1.source_type as type_number,
case when t1.source_table ='HLS_BP_MASTER' then (select nvl(h.eas_bp_code,'HX'||h.bp_code) from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'FND_COMPANY' then (select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'FND_ORG_UNIT' then (select nvl(fou.eas_code,'HX'||fou.unit_id) from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'CON_CONTRACT' and t1.source_type='05' then (select cc.eas_code from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'CON_CONTRACT' and t1.source_type='01' then (select cc.eas_bp_code from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_LN' then (select t.eas_code from csh_payment_req_ln t where t.payment_req_ln_id=t1.source_id) else null end source_number,
case when t1.source_table ='HLS_BP_MASTER' then (select h.bp_name from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'FND_COMPANY' then (select fc.fin_company_name from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'FND_ORG_UNIT' then (select fou.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'CON_CONTRACT' and t1.source_type='05' then (select cc.contract_number from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'CON_CONTRACT' and t1.source_type='01' then (select cc.eas_bp_name from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_LN' then (select t.bp_bank_account_name from csh_payment_req_ln t where t.payment_req_ln_id=t1.source_id) else null end source_name,
case when t1.source_table ='HLS_BP_MASTER' then (select h.bp_name from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'FND_COMPANY' then (select fc.fin_company_name from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'FND_ORG_UNIT' then (select fou.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'CON_CONTRACT' and t1.source_type='05' then (select cc.contract_number from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'CON_CONTRACT' and t1.source_type='01' then (select cc.eas_bp_name from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = t1.source_id) when t1.source_table = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_LN' then (select t.bp_bank_account_name from csh_payment_req_ln t where t.payment_req_ln_id=t1.source_id) else null end description, t1.source_id, t1.source_table from ws_document_record_list t1 where t1.outbound_id =#{outboundId}
